fonts.display: 'HelveticaNowDisplay', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'EditorialNew', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, primary canvas — the dominant near-white that lets photography and type carry all visual weight

palette.name: Warm Ash
palette.role: Elevated surface backgrounds for cards, buttons, and nav pill container — a warm gray one step darker than canvas for subtle layering without shadows

palette.name: Mid Gray
palette.role: Hairline borders, link underlines, and divider lines — sits between canvas and text to create structure without weight

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, button labels, heading copy — a near-pure black with a faint blue undertone for maximum contrast against the warm canvas

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: Navigation borders and secondary text accents — used sparingly where a slightly harder edge is needed

palette.name: Glacial Mist
palette.role: Faint cool-tinted accent on borders and fills — a barely-perceptible icy wash that adds micro-contrast without breaking the monochrome discipline
